
## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)  # read_csv and mutate
library(lme4)       # lmer
library(emmeans)    # emmeans and pairs
library(lmerTest)
library(ordinal)
library(performance)
library(modelsummary)
library(lmerTest)

df_long4 <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_for_R-Study5Pilot2.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict"),
    feature_relevance = relevel(factor(feature_relevance), ref = "relevant"),
    feature_dimension = relevel(factor(feature_dimension), ref = "stripes"),
    stripes_high = relevel(factor(stripes_high), ref = "E"),
    feet_high = relevel(factor(feet_high), ref = "C")
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10
model <- lmer(feature_importance ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension + 
                (1|participant), data = df_long4)
summary(model)

emm <- emmeans(
  model,
  ~ task | feature_relevance * feature_dimension
)

pairs(emm)
```
```{r}

library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

model <- lmer(
  feature_importance ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension + 
    (1 | participant),
  data = df_long4
)

emm <- emmeans(
  model,
  ~ task * feature_dimension | feature_relevance
)

emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)

ggplot(
  emm_df,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = emmean,
    color = task,
    group = task
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    width = .12,
    linewidth = .8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ feature_relevance) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature dimension",
    y = "Predicted feature importance",
    color = "Task",
    title = "Feature importance ratings by task, feature dimension, and relevance"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}


df_long4 <- df_long4 |>
  mutate(
    is_important = feature_importance != 0
  )
model_bin <- glmer(
  is_important ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension +
    (1 | participant),
  data = df_long4,
  family = binomial
)
emm <- emmeans(
  model_bin,
  ~ task * feature_dimension | feature_relevance,
  type = "response"
)

emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm)
ggplot(
  emm_df,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = prob,
    color = task,
    group = task
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = asymp.LCL,
      ymax = asymp.UCL
    ),
    width = .12,
    linewidth = .8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ feature_relevance) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent_format()
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature dimension",
    y = "Probability feature was rated as important",
    color = "Task",
    title = "Probability of assigning a non-zero importance rating"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```


```{r}
df_long4_clmm <- df_long4 |>
  mutate(abs_feature_importance_ord = ordered(abs_feature_importance))

model_clmm <- clmm(abs_feature_importance_ord ~ task * feature_dimension * feature_relevance + (1 | participant), data = df_long4_clmm, link = "logit" )

summary(model_clmm)


emm <- emmeans(
  model_clmm,
  ~ task | feature_dimension * feature_relevance
)

pairs(emm)
```




```{r}
library(ggeffects)
```

```{r}
df_merged <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_merged_for_R_Study4.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict"),

    stripes_relevance = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "stripes", "irrelevant", "relevant"),
    feet_relevance    = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "feet", "irrelevant", "relevant"),

    stripes_match_high = ifelse(stripes == stripes_high, 1, 0),
    feet_match_high    = ifelse(feet == feet_high, 1, 0)
  )

model_trial <- lmer(
  testing_responses ~
    task * stripes_match_high +
    task * feet_match_high +
    (1 | conditionOrder),
  data = df_merged
)
summary(model_trial)
```
```{r}
model_trial2 <- lmer(testing_responses ~
  task * stripes_match_high * stripes_relevance +
  task * feet_match_high * feet_relevance +
  (1 | conditionOrder), data = df_merged)
summary(model_trial2)
```

```{r}
df_merged <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_merged_for_R_Study4.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict")
  )
df_merged <- df_merged |>
  mutate(
    stripes_relevance = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "stripes", "irrelevant", "relevant"),
    feet_relevance  = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "feet", "irrelevant", "relevant")
  )
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)


df_cue <- df_merged |>
  select(
    task, conditionOrder, item, testing_responses,
    relevant_dim, irrelevant_dim,
    stripes_high, feet_high,
    stripes, feet,
    stripes_relevance, feet_relevance
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(
      task, conditionOrder, relevant_dim, irrelevant_dim,
      stripes_high, feet_high, stripes_relevance, feet_relevance
    ),
    names_from = item,
    values_from = testing_responses
  ) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    # Feet effect: high feet minus low feet, holding stripes constant
    feet_effect = case_when(
      feet_high == "F" ~ mean(c(E_F - E_C, W_F - W_C), na.rm = TRUE),
      feet_high == "C" ~ mean(c(E_C - E_F, W_C - W_F), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),

    # Stripes effect: high stripes minus low stripes, holding feet constant
    stripes_effect = case_when(
      stripes_high == "E" ~ mean(c(E_F - W_F, E_C - W_C), na.rm = TRUE),
      stripes_high == "W" ~ mean(c(W_F - E_F, W_C - E_C), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(
    task, conditionOrder, relevant_dim, irrelevant_dim,
    stripes_relevance, feet_relevance,
    feet_effect, stripes_effect
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(feet_effect, stripes_effect),
    names_to = "feature_dimension",
    values_to = "cue_effect"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    feature_dimension = recode(
      feature_dimension,
      feet_effect = "feet",
      stripes_effect = "stripes"
    ),
    feature_relevance = case_when(
      feature_dimension == "feet" ~ feet_relevance,
      feature_dimension == "stripes" ~ stripes_relevance
    ),
    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict"),
    feature_dimension = relevel(factor(feature_dimension), ref = "feet"),
    feature_relevance = relevel(factor(feature_relevance), ref = "irrelevant")
  )
```

```{r}
model_cue <- lmer(
  cue_effect ~ task * feature_relevance * feature_dimension +
    (1 | conditionOrder),
  data = df_cue
)

summary(model_cue)
```

```{r}
# Task comparisons within each feature × relevance combination
emm_cue <- emmeans(
  model_cue,
  ~ task | feature_dimension * feature_relevance
)

emm_cue
pairs(emm_cue, adjust = "bonferroni")

# Optional: all cell means
emm_all <- emmeans(
  model_cue,
  ~ task * feature_dimension * feature_relevance
)

emm_all
```

```{r}
ggplot(df_cue, aes(x = task, y = cue_effect, fill = feature_relevance)) +
  geom_violin(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    alpha = 0.45,
    trim = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = feature_relevance),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, dodge.width = 0.8),
    alpha = 0.35,
    size = 1.3
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    shape = 18,
    size = 4,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ feature_dimension) +
  labs(
    x = "Task",
    y = "High - Low Rating",
    fill = "Feature relevance",
    color = "Feature relevance"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```
```{r}
ggplot(
  df_cue,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = cue_effect,
    color = task,
    group = task
  )
) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_boot,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = .1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ feature_relevance) +
  labs(

  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```
